diagram_previews.alt: Left: top view of the 5 by 5 by 5 cube as a 5 by 5 grid with the red diagonal x = y; the five shaded squares on the diagonal are the tops of the columns of cut cubes. Right: oblique view of the big cube, seen from the front left, with the shaded cutting plane through the front-left vertical edge and the back-right vertical edge (both red, the hidden one dashed) and the red diagonals of the top and bottom faces; an arrow labelled cutting plane points to it.
